The Kachoras Advantage

Why Choose Our Turnkey Services?

Managing different contractors for construction, electrical, plumbing, and aluminium works can lead to delays, extra costs, and coordination problems. At Kachoras, our teams work together from start to finish.

01

One Point of Contact

A dedicated project management team coordinates all site activities, making communication seamless.

02

Better Coordination

Our civil and MEP teams work together from foundation stage to coordinate electrical and plumbing lines.

03

Al Qusais Workshop

Our dedicated aluminium and glass workshop handles custom fabrication directly to site measurements.

04

Cost & Time Control

Eliminating third-party subcontractor markups ensures competitive pricing and on-schedule handovers.

Technical Capabilities & Scope

Four Specialized Contracting Disciplines

All engineering and fabrication works are executed in accordance with Dubai Municipality regulations, Dubai Building Code, DEWA electrical specifications, and Civil Defence safety codes.

01 / Building Contracting

G+1 Villas & Buildings

Complete construction services from foundations to final handover of keys in compliance with Dubai Municipality regulations and engineering standards.

Main Scope of Works:
  • Soil excavation & site preparation
  • Foundation & substructure RCC works
  • Concrete structure & superstructure
  • Blockwork, plastering & masonry
  • AAC blockwork & thermal insulation
  • Residential villas & Majlis extensions
  • Boundary walls & perimeter gates
  • DM inspections & BCC procedures
Completed Reference: Classical Villa – Al Warqaa 4th, Plot 424-7036 License #578964
02 / MEP Engineering

MEP Works & Engineering (HVAC)

Complete mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) services, covering all stages from installation to testing and commissioning.

Main Scope of Works:
  • Electrical wiring, MDB & SMDB panels
  • Power distribution & copper cables
  • Split, ducted split, VRF/VRV & chiller AC
  • Approved subcontractor: Carrier, Daikin, O General, Trane
  • Water supply, drainage & sanitary fixtures
  • Pumps, grease traps & solar water heaters
  • Fire alarm, smoke detection & fire sprinklers
  • DEWA approvals, testing & commissioning
Completed Reference: DEWA Integrated Substation & Infrastructure DEWA Certified
03 / In-House Workshop

Architectural Aluminium & Glass Works

Manufacturing and installation of aluminium doors, windows, skylights, pergolas, glass and mirrors fabricated at our dedicated Al Qusais facility.

Main Scope of Works:
  • Thermal-break aluminium doors & windows
  • Double-glazed curtain walls & facades
  • Heavy-duty sliding & panoramic doors
  • Frameless glass railings & balustrades
  • Aluminium louvers & composite cladding
  • Aluminium pergolas & entrance canopies
  • Glass skylights & insulated glass units (IGU)
  • In-house fabrication at Al Qusais Warehouse B25
Facility Reference: Al Qusais Industrial Area 1 Facility Al Qusais B25
04 / Maintenance & Fit-out

Civil Maintenance & Fit-out Works

Approved contractor for Dubai Municipality General Maintenance Department, MBRHE, and EIB, providing building maintenance, renovation, and interior finishing services.

Main Scope of Works:
  • Decorative gypsum ceilings & false ceilings
  • Cove lighting & decorative ceiling designs
  • Gypsum cornices & classical Arabian majlis work
  • Tile, marble & porcelain floorings
  • Waterproofing & building envelope repairs
  • Custom-made kitchen cabinets & wardrobes
  • Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
  • Dubai Municipality, MBRHE & EIB Approved
Completed Reference: Royal Majlis – Al Barsha, Plot 376-1176 DM & MBRHE Approved
